reason: The final-success observable is support-degenerate under the author SFT warm-start: A_pristine succeeds on only 1/24 paired units, below the preregistered 4/24 floor. With Y nearly always zero, B=0/24 cannot distinguish representation-induced harm from baseline policy incompetence. The experiment therefore cannot identify the downstream treatment effect.
principle: A causal/paired endpoint contrast requires non-degenerate support in the reference policy on the endpoint. Representation integrity and exact negative-control restoration are insufficient when the endpoint has a floor/ceiling.
opposite_cause: The author-released SFT checkpoint is explicitly a warm start for RL and is not the final policy. SkillRL also releases Jianwen/Alfworld-7B-RL, the policy artifact produced by the same ALFWorld/SkillBank training line. Testing a competent final policy is a substrate change justified by the failed support assumption, not a threshold/task rescue.
allowed_next_step: New contract with exactly one predeclared author final RL policy, outcome-blind disjoint competence calibration, then causal intervention only if competence support passes.
